subject.title: qa: canonicalize channel canary and routing scenarios

question: Should the remaining channel routing canonicalization continue through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101076 after conflict repair, or should maintainers split or replace that PR?
rationale: The issue is maintainer-labeled, has an open conflicting candidate PR, and the final path depends on maintainer handling of that PR rather than a safe issue cleanup close.

options.title: Continue through linked PR
options.body: Rebase or repair https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101076, review the QA proof there, and close this issue only after merge.

options.title: Replace with narrower PR
options.body: Close or supersede the current candidate only after opening a narrower branch that preserves the canonical channel routing scope and evidence requirements.

options.title: Decline the direction
options.body: If maintainers no longer want this canonicalization, close both the issue and linked PR with an explicit rationale.

recommendation.title: Continue through linked PR
recommendation.body: Rebase or repair https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101076, review the QA proof there, and close this issue only after merge.

likelyOwner.reason: RomneyDa owns the open candidate PR and has the strongest recent history on canonical QA scenario ownership and Crabline routing.
